articles.title: Binance uncovers wider breach in $6.3 billion exploit, targets Sunday withdrawal restart
articles.snippet: CEO Richard Teng said hackers erased evidence and bypassed security checks. Binance plans to publish its proof of reserves Monday.

articles.title: Binance says 90% of stolen assets replenished, targets Sunday withdrawals
articles.snippet: Less-liquid tokens make up the remaining shortfall as Binance continues buying replacement assets through market and over-the-counter trades.

articles.title: Justin Sun's HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With Financial Watchdog
articles.snippet: The FCA says the Justin Sun-linked exchange will no longer target UK consumers, ending its first case against a crypto firm over marketing.
